_comment: Boundary and reference geography datasets for the India operating area. The staging command (python -m lumon.cli stage-boundaries) downloads each one, records a checksum and writes a simplified copy to data/boundaries/. Nothing here is described as 'official' unless the publisher says so.

datasets.name: India (country polygon, India point of view)
datasets.license: Public domain (Natural Earth terms of use)
datasets.notes: Natural Earth publishes country boundaries as seen by several countries' official points of view. This file is the India point-of-view edition. It is a small-scale (1:10m) cartographic dataset, not a survey-grade or legally authoritative boundary.

datasets.name: India Exclusive Economic Zone (200 NM)
datasets.dataset: Maritime Boundaries Geodatabase: Exclusive Economic Zones (MarineRegions:eez), features with iso_sov1 = IND
datasets.attribution: Flanders Marine Institute (2023). Maritime Boundaries Geodatabase. Available online at https://www.marineregions.org/
datasets.notes: Marine Regions states the data has no legal value and expresses no opinion on the legal status of any boundary. Marine Regions asks users not to redistribute their files, so the downloaded copy stays in data/ and is never committed.

datasets.name: India states and union territories
datasets.provider: geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab), from DataMeet India community / Election Commission of India
datasets.dataset: geoBoundaries gbOpen IND ADM1 (boundaryID IND-ADM1-1811400, year represented 2011), simplified edition
datasets.attribution: geoBoundaries (Runfola et al. 2020); DataMeet India community
datasets.notes: geoBoundaries metadata gives 2011 as the year represented, but the file (36 units) already contains Ladakh (UT since 2019) and the merged Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu (2020). Names include diacritics, e.g. Chhattīsgarh.

datasets.name: India districts
datasets.provider: geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab), from Pathways Data Pvt. Ltd. / lgdirectory.gov.in
datasets.dataset: geoBoundaries gbOpen IND ADM2 (year represented 2021, 736 units), simplified edition
datasets.attribution: geoBoundaries (Runfola et al. 2020); Pathways Data Pvt. Ltd.
datasets.notes: District layout as of 2021. The published simplified file contains 735 features although the geoBoundaries metadata reports 736 units.

datasets.name: Populated places in India
datasets.license: Public domain (Natural Earth terms of use)
datasets.notes: Used for the geographic search gazetteer and major city labels.
